{{Quote|And I figured I'd just take her as co-pilot tomorrow on that mission to Ison.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="A Wookiee Scorned!">{{Tales|10|A Wookiee Scorned!}}</ref>}}
'''Ison''' was a cold, desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ison system/Legends|Ison system]],<ref name="GalGaz">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> and little more than an obscure waypoint on the dangerous [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]].<ref name="wizards" />

Largely considered devoid of any real planets, Ison and the [[Ison system]] itself were little more than a dense [[Asteroid field|debris]] field surrounding the system's [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] star. Large nebula wisps from the corridor encapsulated and suffused the system at differing densities,<ref name="wizards" /> making travel in and around the system an extremely risky venture; this more than anything else contributed greatly to the system's obscurity.<ref name="wizards" /><ref name="EA" /> It was calculated by the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] HazNav (an agency that charted stellar dangers to hyperspace and sublight navigation), that the wisps would entirely close the system off in several centuries, making the system virtually impossible to enter.<ref name="wizards" />

Despite the danger the [[Asteroid field|debris field]] and wisps presented, Ison, rather than [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] to approach [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in order to minimize their chances of detection by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The map published with [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]] indicate Ison was a tropical planet, which contrasts with the image published in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File]] that portrays Ison as a cold and desolate planet.

Both of these images further contradict ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]] (the only two sources that describe Ison in any great detail), which describe Ison as a debris field surrounding the system's [[White dwarf/Legends|White dwarf]], devoid of any planets.

These discrepancies ultimately appear to be resolved in the canon events of [[Star Wars: Uprising]], where debris field and planet are both mentioned in detail.
